notes: This index points to normative properties in the RFCs; it does not replace them. A vector id is a stable label, not a pointer: the CT-Rn prefix records where the id was first filed, and the rfc column states the clause the vector rests on. CT-R5 vectors rest on RFC-1 and RFC-4 clauses; CT-R4-011 to CT-R4-013 rest on the manuscript. IMPLEMENTED means a behavioral test exists in the current runner. DECLARED means the RFC specifies the property but the runner does not test it. RESERVED means the check is identified but the RFC does not specify it.

The runner registers 56 vector IDs (18 core/commit, of which three lifecycle vectors, and 38 extended). Registration alone does not make a vector IMPLEMENTED: 36 extended entries currently return an implementation-gap result without exercising the property. The archived v0.3.1 reports also contain false PASS assessments for C3, CT-R4-005, CT-R4-009, and CT-R4-010; use corrected implementation and current report before making conformance claims.

status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: a behavioral test exists in the current runner.
status_definitions.DECLARED: the RFC specifies the property but the runner does not test it.
status_definitions.RESERVED: the check is identified but the RFC does not specify it.

rows_without_vector.normative_property: Signature verification must be based on canonicalized payloads, not JSON formatting.
Reuse of an idempotency key with a modified action must be rejected.
Requests outside the declared freshness window must be rejected.
A credential signed by a revoked key past its revocation bound must not authorize execution.
UNKNOWN evidence must not be treated as satisfying an invariant; default to HOLD or HARD_VETO.
STALE measurements must be excluded; a critical stale measurement yields HOLD or HARD_VETO.
MISSING evidence must remain distinguishable from other epistemic states.
CONTRADICTORY evidence yields HOLD unless a deterministic, pre-declared resolution applies.
LOW CONFIDENCE must invoke Conservative Admissibility.
The membrane must not invent observations; observations without provenance are invalid for structural evaluation.
Measurements must carry provenance and required contextual bindings.
Interpretations must be produced by deterministic, versioned mappings.
Decisions must derive only from Interpretation and applicable Invariants.
Prohibited inferences must not be used to establish admissibility.
A reason chain must link the decision to interpretations and exact measurements for deterministic reproduction.
Uncertainty must be evaluated against worst-case plausible bounds.
Increasing uncertainty must never expand the Admissible Region.
A hard invariant violation must bypass scoring and produce HARD_VETO.
Confidence modulation may only degrade, never upgrade, the disposition.
Credentials must be checked using public cryptographic material or sufficiently fresh local revocation data.
Verification must not depend on synchronous real-time IAM lookups at the Execution Boundary.
Child authority scope must not exceed parent scope; invalid chain links invalidate descendants.
Credential revocation, policy invocation, context drift, and execution invocation must remain distinct events.
Revocation bounds must be explicit, versioned, and signed.
Revocation after grant but before/during commit must trigger HARD_VETO and a safe-state transition.
Parent revocation and material authority/context changes must invalidate or trigger re-evaluation of affected standing.
Composition must preserve local Standing; recovery must establish a new authorization context.
τ_K and exhaustion behavior must be pre-declared; HOLD expiry defaults to fail-closed, and Shadow Mode requires bounded review capacity.
